# Verde Talent

> Verde Talent is a US job board dedicated to the clean energy industry: solar,
> wind, battery storage, grid and utilities, EV infrastructure, hydrogen, energy
> policy and sustainability. Open roles are updated daily and link straight to
> the employer's application. Searching and applying are free and need no
> account; a free candidate profile is optional and adds weekly job-match emails.
> Employers can post a role from $100. Salary ranges are shown wherever an
> employer discloses them, and the site publishes its own salary benchmarks and
> hiring data. Contact: contact@verdetalent.com

## Key facts (updated October 7, 2026)
- 3,900+ open clean energy jobs, refreshed every day.
- 80 energy companies represented, with open roles in 48 US states.
- 115 salary benchmark pages, 39 career profiles and 62 employer profiles.
- 47 clean energy job terms defined in the glossary.
- Free for job seekers; job postings for employers start at $100.

## Find jobs
- [Job search](https://verdetalent.com/jobs.html): every open role, filterable by sector, location, salary, seniority, work style and skills. Also covers remote and international roles.
- [Browse by location and role](https://verdetalent.com/browse.html): pages for each sector, job function and state - for example solar jobs in Texas, or wind technician jobs nationally.
- [Companies hiring](https://verdetalent.com/companies.html): the 80 energy companies on Verde Talent, with their open role counts.
- Employer profiles, one page each, at https://verdetalent.com/companies/<employer-slug>.html - for example [Vestas](https://verdetalent.com/companies/vestas.html) or [First Solar](https://verdetalent.com/companies/first-solar.html): open roles, where that employer is hiring, what it posts most and what its postings advertise.

## Pay and career research
- [Salary benchmarks](https://verdetalent.com/salaries.html): what clean energy roles pay, by role and state, drawn from posted salary ranges.
- [Career profiles](https://verdetalent.com/careers.html): what each role does, the skills asked for, entry-level share, where the jobs are and which employers hire for it.
- [Training and certifications](https://verdetalent.com/professional-development.html): career pathways and certifications by sector (NABCEP, GWO, NERC, EVITP, LEED and others).
- [Hiring data and market intelligence](https://verdetalent.com/intelligence.html): where clean energy hiring is happening, which employers are hiring most, what roles pay, and the capacity being built next.

## Reports
- [Clean Energy Hiring Reports](https://verdetalent.com/reports/): a monthly look at where US clean energy is being built, what field roles pay, how to get in, and a role of the month.
- Latest: [October 2026: Texas is building a third of America's clean energy. It has less than a tenth of the workers.](https://verdetalent.com/reports/2026-10-clean-energy-hiring.html)

## Definitions
- [Clean energy jobs glossary](https://verdetalent.com/glossary.html): 47 industry terms - NABCEP, GWO, BESS, interconnection, PPA, O&M, prevailing wage and others - defined plainly, each with the number of open postings using it today.

## News
- [Clean energy news](https://verdetalent.com/news.html): weekly industry and hiring news, with a free email briefing.
- [News feed (RSS)](https://verdetalent.com/feed.xml)

## For employers
- [Post a job](https://verdetalent.com/post-job.html): $100 for a 30-day posting or $150 for 60 days; 5- and 10-post packs work out at $90 and $85 per post.
- [Hiring and recruiting data](https://verdetalent.com/hire.html): hiring volumes, posted salary benchmarks and the employers competing for the same talent.

## For candidates
- [Create a free profile](https://verdetalent.com/create-profile.html): optional; adds weekly job-match emails and lets employers find you.
- [Resume Vault](https://verdetalent.com/resume-vault.html)

## About
- [About Verde Talent](https://verdetalent.com/about.html): what the site is and who runs it.
- [All pages (sitemap)](https://verdetalent.com/sitemap.xml)
